facts.fact: The CMSS (Caisse Malienne de Securite Sociale) presented a digital pension payment scheme whose pilot with the Banque de Developpement du Mali was concluded as conclusive and is ready for phased rollout to other partner banks, with payment orders issued digitally through to settlement.
The document refers to the success of the CMSS's mobile payment of pensions, which the bank payment scheme follows; it gives no date or figures for the mobile payments.
